envelope.description: Implement the installation mutation gate and journal

body.title: Implement the installation mutation gate and journal
body.summary: Add installation-local arbitration, durable controller identity and reservations, transaction stages and recovery decisions. Serialize ordinary restart as a single reservation. Bind each mutation to the current owner and update ID where applicable.
acceptanceChecks: Stale sockets, reused owner PID, unrelated controllers and orphan reservations cannot mutate
Recovery branches on the matching durable outcome before any destructive action

tests.name: Durable update reservation blocks competing mutations and binds the owner
Admission rejects foreign update IDs, owner PID reuse and connections opened before lease publication
Recovery classification distinguishes uncommitted, committed, rolled-back and fenced transactions
Two independent processes cannot reserve the same installation or clear an unverified orphan reservation
Controller death releases short arbitration but preserves the durable reservation
Public lifecycle admission remains busy while an update owns the installation
